Name: Igloo Furniture for DGA or Alternative Textures
Author: glymr
Description:
Have you ever wanted an igloo of your very own? Do you look at the igloos at the Ice Festival and say, "Why can't I get one of those?" Have you ever wanted to build 100 igloos all over Pelican Town in an INVASION OF IGLOOS because you are an IGLOO INVADER???

Well now you can! Thanks to the magic of mods, you can have a non-melting igloo of your very own that lasts all year round. Install the DGA version and you can buy an igloo from Robin or get one for free from the furniture catalogue. With the Alternative Textures version, you can change the appearance of the Modern Tea-Table (not the Modern Table) and put together your own igloo DIY-style!

You can walk behind the DGA version, but the Alternative Textures version is solid and can't be walked behind or through (including around the edges).

To use Alternative Textures, you'll need to purchase a paint can from Robin and equip it, then click on the item you want to change, in this case, the Modern Tea-Table. You will need four Modern Tea-Tables placed in a square, and then you can apply the igloo textures to each piece.

Using two or three pieces, you can also create an effect where it looks like the igloo is next to or behind another building. See the 9th picture for an example.

I created these mods for the Stardew Valley Discord 2023 Winter Team Event.

Have fun invading, Igloo Invaders!
